title: Digital Clocks
description: Decorate your desk and wall with clocks :)
body:
Digital Clock adds realistic, fully functional, and highly customizable clocks to Minecraft. Not only do they look great as decoration, but they also display accurate time (Game Time, System Time, or Custom) and feature working alarms!

![Digital and analog clocks are available here! You can choose and decorate whichever you like :)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RdkWxwhk/images/53d91880b1bc582c8b7aa1a18ebbfd77068b8bd0.png)

**3 Time Modes** 

Display in-game time (Game Time), real-world computer time (System Time), or your own manual time (Custom).

**Digital Desk Clocks**

![You can use it both as a desk clock and as an alarm clock. Whichever you prefer!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RdkWxwhk/images/cec4ac95568fcfe617329fe510d2f309520edf3e.png)

**Working Alarms** 

![Set up alarms easily via the UI. When the time comes, they will ring with a custom alarm sound.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RdkWxwhk/images/2ec8ec66ca7bcc7464899d403bf02b8fb25089dc.png)
Set up alarms easily via the UI. When the time comes, they will ring with a custom alarm sound.

**Huge Variety**

Digital & Analog Wall Clocks, Desk Clocks, and Twin Bell Clocks. (Each comes in 9 different color options!).

**Wrist Watch** 
-![You can check your watch by pressing the R key. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8eca750223e18d5746e8dc019a1663558782206a_0.webp)

Check your watch, by pressing the R key. You can set your watch by pressing the R and Shift keys simultaneously. 

**Led Analog Clocks**

![It doesn't just have a regular analog clock :)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RdkWxwhk/images/ee3d5067762b5feb0708d7e3f5415bd1cb742c3b.png)

**Detailed Interface**

![Right-click to manage settings like 12/24-hour format, display seconds, and a sleek Standby LED when the screen is turned off.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d45374fe04e8a9a64c7adc87c7cdf5f03a02a38.png)

Perfect for modernizing your bases and keeping track of time in style!
